subject: Vendor portal SSO, PO requirements and self-bill exemption request
messages:
From: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@orchidmed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@orchidmed.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood Inference

Hi Ben,

We're starting the vendor registration for Redwood so AP can issue POs and route payments. A few asks from procurement and AP: 

- We need Redwood to register in our vendor portal (vendor.orchidmed.com). Can you confirm your preferred company legal name, tax ID, and primary remit bank details?
- For EU invoices we need a VAT certificate on file (we have an EU entity requirement).
- Orchid typically uses 'self-billing' for marketplace vendors; we'd like to request a self-bill exemption/waiver signed by Redwood if possible, so our system can generate invoices on your behalf.
- PO matching: AP requires the PO number printed on the invoice header and an itemized line showing the contract subscription or usage period.

Can you provide the docs and let me know if you accept self-billing (we can send a DocuSign waiver)? Also let us know who should be invited to the portal and whether you use SSO (SAML) for vendor logins.

Thanks,
Liam O'Donnell
Procurement Manager
Orchid Medical Systems

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@orchidmed.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up. Happy to get Redwood provisioned. Quick answers up front:

- Legal name for vendor portal: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (US EIN): 82-3456789 (we'll attach an executed W-9 for your records).
- For EU VAT: we can provide our EU VAT certificate and confirm which legal entity you'll be onboarding.
- Bank remittance: we will attach a signed bank mandate (PDF) with our ACH details — if you prefer an IBAN for EU payments let us know and we'll include that in the mandate.
- Self-billing waiver: we can sign a waiver. Please send the DocuSign and we'll review. Redwood's legal prefers the waiver to be scoped to PO-based self-bill invoices only (no retrospective billing).
- Portal SSO: we do support SAML SSO. Point us at the metadata URL / IdP fields and our IT will coordinate. Otherwise we can create a vendor portal account manually.

I've attached our standard Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf to speed things along (shows preferred invoice layout and PO placement). I'll loop in our finance lead for any tax/payment specifics.

Next steps suggested:
1) Send DocuSign link for self-bill waiver (we'll counter-sign).
2) Portal invite for ben.carter@redwood.ai + soojin.lee@redwood.ai (SSO optional).
3) I'll upload W-9, EU VAT cert and bank mandate once I have the DocuSign and portal confirmation.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Vendor registration & PO requirements — finance follow-up

Ben — forwarding procurement's ask. A couple items from finance: 

- Confirm whether Redwood will invoice net30 or if Orchid requires 45/60 day terms. We normally invoice net30.
- For EU customers: if Orchid will self-bill, confirm whether they will apply reverse-charge or VAT on the invoices. We need the VAT handling noted on the waiver.
- Please provide the W-9 (or W-8 if non-US entity), bank mandate (signed PDF), and the EU VAT certificate. We'll attach these to the vendor record.

If you're comfortable, attach the three docs in reply to the portal invite so AP can complete setup.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kelly.finance@redwood.ai
